lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately six vertical columns of high-intensity circular clusters are visible posterior to the gill slits, forming a non-uniform grid arrangement across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Linear vertical bands of higher luminance intersect with horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating well-defined anchor nodes especially prominent in the second and third columns posterior to the pectoral fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge to lower-intensity shadow pixels on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small irregular notch-like indentation present on the posterior trailing margin of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (Echeneidae) attached to the dorsal-lateral surface and schooling beneath the ventral region.
